```python
import pyautogui, time
pyautogui.write("python3 - <<'PY'
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import RGBColor
import re, shutil, os
path=os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/Dolch_Sight_Words_Primer.docx')
backup=path+'.bak'
if not os.path.exists(backup): shutil.copy2(path, backup)
doc=Document(path)
vowels=set('aeiouAEIOU')
word_re=re.compile(r'([A-Za-z]+)')
def color_paragraph(p):
    items=[]
    for run in list(p.runs):
        txt=run.text
        style=run.style
        bold, italic, underline = run.bold, run.italic, run.underline
        font=run.font
        name, size = font.name, font.size
        for part in re.split(r'([A-Za-z]+)', txt):
            if part=='': continue
            col=None
            if part[0].isalpha(): col=RGBColor(255,0,0) if part[0] in vowels else RGBColor(0,0,255)
            items.append((part, style, bold, italic, underline, name, size, col))
    for run in list(p.runs):
        p._element.remove(run._element)
    for text, style, bold, italic, underline, name, size, col in items:
        r=p.add_run(text)
        try: r.style=style
        except Exception: pass
        r.bold, r.italic, r.underline = bold, italic, underline
        if name: r.font.name=name
        if size: r.font.size=size
        if col: r.font.color.rgb=col
for p in doc.paragraphs: color_paragraph(p)
for table in doc.tables:
    for row in table.rows:
        for cell in row.cells:
            for p in cell.paragraphs: color_paragraph(p)
doc.save(path)
print('DONE colored vowel-starting words red and non-vowel-starting words blue:', path)
PY
", interval=0.001)
time.sleep(0.5)
```
